S.FORM: T mi nukay a maemin kiya wawa isu.
S.PHON: t mi nukaj a maəmin kija wawa isu
S.FORM: T mi nukay a maemin kiya wawa isu.
S.PHON: t mi nukaj a maəmin kija wawa isu
S.TRANSL: 妳的小孩都回來了嗎?
Did all your children come home?

S.FORM: P awaay minukay u mikadafuaytu cangra ira kuni minukay itira i timul.
S.PHON: p awaaj minukaj u mika[ɬ|ɮ]afuajtu ʦaŋra ira kuni minukaj itira i timuɾ
S.FORM: P awaay minukay u mikadafuaytu cangra ira kuni minukay itira i timul.
S.PHON: p awaaj minukaj u mika[ɬ|ɮ]afuajtu ʦaŋra ira kuni minukaj itira i timuɾ
S.TRANSL: 沒有回來,她們都嫁了,回到南邊(男方)的家.
(No,) they didn't. They are all married and returned to the hometown of their spouse in the south.

S.FORM: itira i pikadafuan nira T a ca'ay pinukay tayni i luma' P ira inacila milisu' patikutu tayra.
S.PHON: itira i pika[ɬ|ɮ]afuan nira t a ʦaʡaj pinukaj tajni i ɾumaʡ p ira inaʦiɾa miɾisuʡ patikutu tajra
S.FORM: itira i pikadafuan nira T a ca'ay pinukay tayni i luma' P ira inacila milisu' patikutu tayra.
S.PHON: itira i pika[ɬ|ɮ]afuan nira t a ʦaʡaj pinukaj tajni i ɾumaʡ p ira inaʦiɾa miɾisuʡ patikutu tajra
S.TRANSL: 回到夫婿的家.T: 啊,沒回到家來嗎?P: 昨天有回來拜訪之後就回去了.
To the home of their spouse. Oh, didn't (they) come home? Yesterday, they visited, (but) left (right away).

S.FORM: en latek anudafak dadaya iratu cangra tayni T ah maherektu kamu tayra i tadem.
S.PHON: ən ɾatək anu[ɬ|ɮ]afak [ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]aja iratu ʦaŋra tajni t aħ maħərəktu kamu tajra i ta[ɬ|ɮ]əm
S.FORM: en latek anudafak dadaya iratu cangra tayni T ah maherektu kamu tayra i tadem.
S.PHON: ən ɾatək anu[ɬ|ɮ]afak [ɬ|ɮ]a[ɬ|ɮ]aja iratu ʦaŋra tajni t aħ maħərəktu kamu tajra i ta[ɬ|ɮ]əm
S.TRANSL: 可能明天晚上又回來了. 妳們掃墓結束了嗎?
They would probably come (again) tomorrow night. Oh, have you finished (cleaning up your ancestors') tombs?

S.FORM: P cah caho caho misanga matayal anini tunu tadem kami icila misangatu miliyaw tu tadem niya wina tiya mama.
S.PHON: p ʦaħ ʦaħ[o|u] ʦaħ[o|u] misaŋa matajaɾ anini tunu ta[ɬ|ɮ]əm kami iʦiɾa misaŋatu miɾijaw tu ta[ɬ|ɮ]əm nija wina tija mama
S.FORM: P cah caho caho misanga matayal anini tunu tadem kami icila misangatu miliyaw tu tadem niya wina tiya mama.
S.PHON: p ʦaħ ʦaħ[o|u] ʦaħ[o|u] misaŋa matajaɾ anini tunu ta[ɬ|ɮ]əm kami iʦiɾa misaŋatu miɾijaw tu ta[ɬ|ɮ]əm nija wina tija mama
S.TRANSL: 還沒,我們現在還在整理墳墓.幾天前我們整理、翻修媽媽爸爸的墳墓.
Not yet, we're still cleaning. A few days ago we cleaned Mother's and Father's tombs.

S.FORM: T a P mapela' kiya sulafu nira haw cinanum ku laluma.
S.PHON: t a p mapəɾaʡ kija suɾafu nira ħaw ʦinanum ku ɾaɾuma
S.FORM: T a P mapela' kiya sulafu nira haw cinanum ku laluma.
S.PHON: t a p mapəɾaʡ kija suɾafu nira ħaw ʦinanum ku ɾaɾuma
S.TRANSL: 鋼筋水泥裂了,水滲進裡面了.
The cement cracked and so water leaked inside.

S.FORM: T hai mahaen mapela' kiya niyam.
S.PHON: t ħai maħaən mapəɾaʡ kija nijam
S.FORM: T hai mahaen mapela' kiya niyam.
S.PHON: t ħai maħaən mapəɾaʡ kija nijam
S.TRANSL: 是的,一樣,我們的也裂了.
Right, ours also cracked.

S.FORM: P miliyaw kami icila sa.
S.PHON: p miɾijaw kami iʦiɾa sa
S.FORM: P miliyaw kami icila sa.
S.PHON: p miɾijaw kami iʦiɾa sa
S.TRANSL: 我們前幾天翻修.
We have started to work a few days ago.

S.FORM: T misanga'an P milepuntu anini haw han pipaherek han mipacuk tu fafuy.
S.PHON: t misaŋaʡan p miɾəpuntu anini ħaw ħan pipaħərək ħan mipaʦuk tu fafuj
S.FORM: T misanga'an P milepuntu anini haw han pipaherek han mipacuk tu fafuy.
S.PHON: t misaŋaʡan p miɾəpuntu anini ħaw ħan pipaħərək ħan mipaʦuk tu fafuj
S.TRANSL: 今天要完工了.工作完成,趁這個機會(子女都回來),我們今天要殺豬.
We should be able to finish today. Once we are done, we will kill a pig (today).

S.FORM: T ho fangcal kira.
S.PHON: t ħ[o|u] faŋʦaɾ kira
S.FORM: T ho fangcal kira.
S.PHON: t ħ[o|u] faŋʦaɾ kira
S.TRANSL: 哦,很好阿.
Good!

S.FORM: P hay.
S.PHON: p ħaj
S.FORM: P hay.
S.PHON: p ħaj
S.TRANSL: 是的.
Right!

S.FORM: T ya maherektu i dafak caho.
S.PHON: t ja maħərəktu i [ɬ|ɮ]afak ʦaħ[o|u]
S.FORM: T ya maherektu i dafak caho.
S.PHON: t ja maħərəktu i [ɬ|ɮ]afak ʦaħ[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 早上做好了嗎,還沒好嗎?
Have you finished this morning?

S.FORM: P mamalepun anini sa'an.
S.PHON: p mamaɾəpun anini saʡan
S.FORM: P mamalepun anini sa'an.
S.PHON: p mamaɾəpun anini saʡan
S.TRANSL: 今天說是會完成.
We would finish today.

S.FORM: sa mipacuk anini mipacuktu i dafak ya fafuy.
S.PHON: sa mipaʦuk anini mipaʦuktu i [ɬ|ɮ]afak ja fafuj
S.FORM: sa mipacuk anini mipacuktu i dafak ya fafuy.
S.PHON: sa mipaʦuk anini mipaʦuktu i [ɬ|ɮ]afak ja fafuj
S.TRANSL: 所以今天要殺豬,早上就殺了.
We already killed a pig this morning.

S.FORM: T a a fangcal kira.
S.PHON: t a a faŋʦaɾ kira
S.FORM: T a a fangcal kira.
S.PHON: t a a faŋʦaɾ kira
S.TRANSL: 喔,那很好阿.
That's good.

S.FORM: P ya ci aciang a ci namuh kura citudungay mi'aca tuya fafuy.
S.PHON: p ja ʦi aʦiaŋ a ʦi namuħ kura ʦitu[ɬ|ɮ]uŋaj miʡaʦa tuja fafuj
S.FORM: P ya ci aciang a ci namuh kura citudungay mi'aca tuya fafuy.
S.PHON: p ja ʦi aʦiaŋ a ʦi namuħ kura ʦitu[ɬ|ɮ]uŋaj miʡaʦa tuja fafuj
S.TRANSL: Aciang跟Namuh負責買那頭豬.
Aciang and Namuh bought the pig.

FORM.notes: source note: ati’可以直接用於口語，叫人家「過來」的意思。

S.FORM: XXXX sa ati'han ni ofad malahok cangra itira malahok.
S.PHON: xxxx sa atiʡħan ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] maɾaħ[o|u]k ʦaŋra itira maɾaħ[o|u]k
S.FORM: XXXX sa ati'han ni ofad malahok cangra itira malahok.
S.PHON: xxxx sa atiʡħan ni [o|u]fa[ɬ|ɮ] maɾaħ[o|u]k ʦaŋra itira maɾaħ[o|u]k
S.TRANSL: 所以Ofad叫他們吃午餐,就在那邊吃了.
Ofad invited them (for lunch) there.

S.FORM: T i honi P hai.
S.PHON: t i ħ[o|u]ni p ħai
S.FORM: T i honi P hai.
S.PHON: t i ħ[o|u]ni p ħai
S.TRANSL: 剛才嗎? 是阿.
Just now? Right!

S.FORM: T ha P a tayraho malafi anuhoni.
S.PHON: t ħa p a tajraħ[o|u] maɾafi anuħ[o|u]ni
S.FORM: T ha P a tayraho malafi anuhoni.
S.PHON: t ħa p a tajraħ[o|u] maɾafi anuħ[o|u]ni
S.TRANSL: 等一下還要去哪裡吃晚餐?
So (you're) going there for dinner later?

S.FORM: T o P XXXX T XXXX fangcal kira P m T anudafak kami a tayra tu niyam patien XXXX tiya patademan P a pipatademan.
S.PHON: t [o|u] p xxxx t xxxx faŋʦaɾ kira p m t anu[ɬ|ɮ]afak kami a tajra tu nijam patiən xxxx tija pata[ɬ|ɮ]əman p a pipata[ɬ|ɮ]əman
S.FORM: T o P XXXX T XXXX fangcal kira P m T anudafak kami a tayra tu niyam patien XXXX tiya patademan P a pipatademan.
S.PHON: t [o|u] p xxxx t xxxx faŋʦaɾ kira p m t anu[ɬ|ɮ]afak kami a tajra tu nijam patiən xxxx tija pata[ɬ|ɮ]əman p a pipata[ɬ|ɮ]əman
S.TRANSL: 我們的是明天早上八點去墳墓. 去掃墓嗎?
We are going (to clean up) the tombs at 8 o'clock tomorrow. To (clean up) the tombs?

S.FORM: T nawhani.
S.PHON: t nawħani
S.FORM: T nawhani.
S.PHON: t nawħani
S.TRANSL: 為什麼呢?
Why?

S.FORM: awa ku limaw nuya a wawa. XXXX
S.PHON: awa ku ɾimaw nuja a wawa xxxx
S.FORM: awa ku limaw nuya a wawa. XXXX
S.PHON: awa ku ɾimaw nuja a wawa xxxx
S.TRANSL: 那些小孩沒有時間回來.
The children don't have time to come home.

S.FORM: a i honi a minukay ca nufu na i pusung.
S.PHON: a i ħ[o|u]ni a minukaj ʦa nufu na i pusuŋ
S.FORM: a i honi a minukay ca nufu na i pusung.
S.PHON: a i ħ[o|u]ni a minukaj ʦa nufu na i pusuŋ
S.TRANSL: Nufu一家人剛剛從台東回來.
Nufu (and his family) just came from Taitung.

S.FORM: P ca ca hekaw i awa minukay.
S.PHON: p ʦa ʦa ħəkaw i awa minukaj
S.FORM: P ca ca hekaw i awa minukay.
S.PHON: p ʦa ʦa ħəkaw i awa minukaj
S.TRANSL: Hekaw一家人沒有回來嗎?
Didn't Hekaw come home?

S.FORM: T a ca'ay pinukay cingra awa ku limaw.
S.PHON: t a ʦaʡaj pinukaj ʦiŋra awa ku ɾimaw
S.FORM: T a ca'ay pinukay cingra awa ku limaw.
S.PHON: t a ʦaʡaj pinukaj ʦiŋra awa ku ɾimaw
S.TRANSL: 他沒回來,沒有時間.
(They) didn't come home; they didn't have time.

S.FORM: XXXX P m ca'ay karolay kisu tu kapihiya.
S.PHON: xxxx p m ʦaʡaj kar[o|u]ɾaj kisu tu kapiħija
S.FORM: XXXX P m ca'ay karolay kisu tu kapihiya.
S.PHON: xxxx p m ʦaʡaj kar[o|u]ɾaj kisu tu kapiħija
S.TRANSL: 做這一件事你不會累嗎?
Aren't you tired doing this?

S.FORM: T hai maulah kaku mi tengil.
S.PHON: t ħai mauɾaħ kaku mi təŋiɾ
S.FORM: T hai maulah kaku mi tengil.
S.PHON: t ħai mauɾaħ kaku mi təŋiɾ
S.TRANSL: 不會,我喜歡聽.
No, I like to listen.

S.FORM: P hai i fangcal.
S.PHON: p ħai i faŋʦaɾ
S.FORM: P hai i fangcal.
S.PHON: p ħai i faŋʦaɾ
S.TRANSL: 那很好.
That's good.

FORM.notes: source note: mi-sa-heci這裡作為「解釋」之意。

S.FORM: T edeng nika mafukil tu nu holam a misaheci.
S.PHON: t ə[ɬ|ɮ]əŋ nika mafukiɾ tu nu ħ[o|u]ɾam a misaħəʦi
S.FORM: T edeng nika mafukil tu nu holam a misaheci.
S.PHON: t ə[ɬ|ɮ]əŋ nika mafukiɾ tu nu ħ[o|u]ɾam a misaħəʦi
S.TRANSL: 只是,不會用漢語解釋.
But I can't explain in Chinese.

S.FORM: anu ira kura kafukilan P hang T ca P maten T u kira XXXX P maten matenes mi saliyaliyaw sumuwal hai.
S.PHON: anu ira kura kafukiɾan p ħaŋ t ʦa p matən t u kira xxxx p matən matənəs mi saɾijaɾijaw sumuwaɾ ħai
S.FORM: anu ira kura kafukilan P hang T ca P maten T u kira XXXX P maten matenes mi saliyaliyaw sumuwal hai.
S.PHON: anu ira kura kafukiɾan p ħaŋ t ʦa p matən t u kira xxxx p matən matənəs mi saɾijaɾijaw sumuwaɾ ħai
S.TRANSL: 如果有不會的地方,持續反反覆覆的說,是不是?
If there is something I don't know, lots of repetitions, right?

S.FORM: T hai P kaku ma mahaen.
S.PHON: t ħai p kaku ma maħaən
S.FORM: T hai P kaku ma mahaen.
S.PHON: t ħai p kaku ma maħaən
S.TRANSL: 我也是.
Me too.

S.FORM: kaku mafana' kaku tu nu kaping haw matini matini sa'an cangra haw.
S.PHON: kaku mafanaʡ kaku tu nu kapiŋ ħaw matini matini saʡan ʦaŋra ħaw
S.FORM: kaku mafana' kaku tu nu kaping haw matini matini sa'an cangra haw.
S.PHON: kaku mafanaʡ kaku tu nu kapiŋ ħaw matini matini saʡan ʦaŋra ħaw
S.TRANSL: 我雖然會說國語,他們說＂這樣子、這樣子＂.
Although I know Mandarin, (they) would say, 'Like this? Like this?'.

S.FORM: ira kura kafana'an aku haw.
S.PHON: ira kura kafanaʡan aku ħaw
S.FORM: ira kura kafana'an aku haw.
S.PHON: ira kura kafanaʡan aku ħaw
S.TRANSL: 有我所知道的.
There are some (answers) that I know.

S.FORM: roma anu mafukil kaku misaharaterateng haw ca'ay kangaay matini sa cangra haw.
S.PHON: r[o|u]ma anu mafukiɾ kaku misaħaratəratəŋ ħaw ʦaʡaj kaŋaaj matini sa ʦaŋra ħaw
S.FORM: roma anu mafukil kaku misaharaterateng haw ca'ay kangaay matini sa cangra haw.
S.PHON: r[o|u]ma anu mafukiɾ kaku misaħaratəratəŋ ħaw ʦaʡaj kaŋaaj matini sa ʦaŋra ħaw
S.TRANSL: 其次,如果有我不知道,正在思索的時候,他們說＂不可以這樣子嗎?＂
If I don't know and when I am thinking, they would say, 'Can't we say this?'

S.FORM: matamaitu.
S.PHON: matamaitu
S.FORM: matamaitu.
S.PHON: matamaitu
S.TRANSL: 結果,答案對了(找到答案了).
And (they) had the answer.

S.FORM: T P cangra ku patalahekaray sa haw.
S.PHON: t p ʦaŋra ku pataɾaħəkaraj sa ħaw
S.FORM: T P cangra ku patalahekaray sa haw.
S.PHON: t p ʦaŋra ku pataɾaħəkaraj sa ħaw
S.TRANSL: 結果(將其中涵義)表達出來的人也是他們自己.
They found an answer by themselves.

S.FORM: a hai matira kura matama han.
S.PHON: a ħai matira kura matama ħan
S.FORM: a hai matira kura matama han.
S.PHON: a ħai matira kura matama ħan
S.TRANSL: (我就會說)＂是的,就是這樣,如此如此.＂
I wouls day, 'Right, like that'.

S.FORM: ira ku maha'enay nu maku cangranan.
S.PHON: ira ku maħaʡənaj nu maku ʦaŋranan
S.FORM: ira ku maha'enay nu maku cangranan.
S.PHON: ira ku maħaʡənaj nu maku ʦaŋranan
S.TRANSL: 我也有同樣的情形在他們身上.
I have the same experience.

S.FORM: T a fangcal kira P hai nika u nuninian kahmaw ku nuninian.
S.PHON: t a faŋʦaɾ kira p ħai nika u nuninian kaħmaw ku nuninian
S.FORM: T a fangcal kira P hai nika u nuninian kahmaw ku nuninian.
S.PHON: t a faŋʦaɾ kira p ħai nika u nuninian kaħmaw ku nuninian
S.TRANSL: 很好啊. 是,不過這次(問題)比較簡單.
That's good! Yes, but it's easier this time.

S.FORM: ca'ay kamatira tu nuriraw tusa tu kala kala sa satapangan aku ka'emed kununinian a misanga'an.
S.PHON: ʦaʡaj kamatira tu nuriraw tusa tu kaɾa kaɾa sa satapaŋan aku kaʡəmə[ɬ|ɮ] kununinian a misaŋaʡan
S.FORM: ca'ay kamatira tu nuriraw tusa tu kala kala sa satapangan aku ka'emed kununinian a misanga'an.
S.PHON: ʦaʡaj kamatira tu nuriraw tusa tu kaɾa kaɾa sa satapaŋan aku kaʡəmə[ɬ|ɮ] kununinian a misaŋaʡan
S.TRANSL: 不像那二個人,我剛開始的時候,做這個(採集)很容易.
Not like the two, when I just started, this (collecting data) is easy.

S.FORM: T anu ca ca ka tama haw anu hacuwa kura kafana'an mi P hai hai anu ma T pasadak han hai.
S.PHON: t anu ʦa ʦa ka tama ħaw anu ħaʦuwa kura kafanaʡan mi p ħai ħai anu ma t pasa[ɬ|ɮ]ak ħan ħai
S.FORM: T anu ca ca ka tama haw anu hacuwa kura kafana'an mi P hai hai anu ma T pasadak han hai.
S.PHON: t anu ʦa ʦa ka tama ħaw anu ħaʦuwa kura kafanaʡan mi p ħai ħai anu ma t pasa[ɬ|ɮ]ak ħan ħai
S.TRANSL: 雖然答非所問,如果你了解多少,就表達出來.
Even though (you) cannot find an answer, regardless of how much you know,(you) can express it.

S.FORM: P matatudung aca tu hati mahaen aku.
S.PHON: p matatu[ɬ|ɮ]uŋ aʦa tu ħati maħaən aku
S.FORM: P matatudung aca tu hati mahaen aku.
S.PHON: p matatu[ɬ|ɮ]uŋ aʦa tu ħati maħaən aku
S.TRANSL: 如果意思很接近,剛剛好的,我也是這樣子做.
If the meaning is close, I did so too.

FORM.notes: source note: hiya 指採集時被問到的其他問題。

S.FORM: matatudungitu haw hatiraen aca aku ca'aytu kafilu kura hiya misama'ama'an kira.
S.PHON: matatu[ɬ|ɮ]uŋitu ħaw ħatiraən aʦa aku ʦaʡajtu kafiɾu kura ħija misamaʡamaʡan kira
S.FORM: matatudungitu haw hatiraen aca aku ca'aytu kafilu kura hiya misama'ama'an kira.
S.PHON: matatu[ɬ|ɮ]uŋitu ħaw ħatiraən aʦa aku ʦaʡajtu kafiɾu kura ħija misamaʡamaʡan kira
S.TRANSL: (表達內涵)很接近了的時候,我是這樣子做,其他的方式也無法勝任了.
If the expression is close, I do it like this, but I'm not able to help with the others.

S.FORM: T u roma anu mi falicen ta misanuamis haw anu patatama anuhan ita tura suwal nu holam u roma i ku'esit a tengilen.
S.PHON: t u r[o|u]ma anu mi faɾiʦən ta misanuamis ħaw anu patatama anuħan ita tura suwaɾ nu ħ[o|u]ɾam u r[o|u]ma i kuʡəsit a təŋiɾən
S.FORM: T u roma anu mi falicen ta misanuamis haw anu patatama anuhan ita tura suwal nu holam u roma i ku'esit a tengilen.
S.PHON: t u r[o|u]ma anu mi faɾiʦən ta misanuamis ħaw anu patatama anuħan ita tura suwaɾ nu ħ[o|u]ɾam u r[o|u]ma i kuʡəsit a təŋiɾən
S.TRANSL: 其次,如果我們翻譯成阿美語,如果我們硬要符合漢語的話,聽起來硬梆梆的.
Then, if we translate it into Amis, if we have to (conform to) Chinese, (the expression would) sound awkward.

S.FORM: P mhm hai hai.
